text:
Sam: RFC follow-up: proposing a compact 3-state lease lifecycle for credits ingest to reduce double-counts when finalizer lags. PROVISIONAL -> DEFERRED -> FINALIZED/RECLAIMABLE.
Mira: what makes DEFERRED different from current timed eviction?
Sam: DEFERRED is a hold state that preserves provenance and prevents auto-reemit. we attach a causality tag and short retry window. if finalizer later finalizes we transition to FINALIZED; otherwise after defer_window we mark RECLAIMABLE and emit reclaim events.
Andrew: key win is avoiding transient double-emits when cross-region finalizer watermark stalls. curious about how we detect "stalls" robustly.
Oz: detection should combine watermark gap + lack of finalizer heartbeats + queue aging. single-signal heuristics led to flapping before.
Jess: ops impact: how does this affect auditing and downstream billing? auditors must know DEFERRED is not billable. we need a `lease_status` field in audit events.
Sam: agree. event shapes: emit `lease_event` with `status` in [provisional,deferred,finalized,reclaimable] and `provenance_tag` like `pfx:<fingerprint>:<counter>`. auditors dedupe on provenance_tag.
Mira: sample event snippet?
Sam: code:
```
{ "lease_id": "L-123", "status": "deferred", "provenance_tag": "pfx:abc123:42", "reason": "watermark_gap" }
```
Oz: we should avoid large new fields in hot path. `provenance_tag` can be compact base62.
Andrew: rollout plan? we need backwards-compatible signals for older consumers. maybe emit `lease_deferred` legacy event plus new `lease_event` for new pipeline.
Jess: ops runbook items: inspect `defer_queue`, force-revalidate a sample, backfill provenance for historical provisional leases older than migration_cutoff. add dashboard: `defer_rate`, `defer_age_p50/p95`, `revalidation_success_rate`.
Sam: config knobs: `defer_window_ms`, `defer_queue_high_water`, `revalidate_sample_k`, `watermark_gap_threshold_ms`. example: {"defer_window_ms":"30000","revalidate_sample_k":"200","watermark_gap_threshold_ms":"10000"}
Mira: per-tenant override needed. enterprise customers with strict accounting may want shorter defer windows and stronger revalidation.
Oz: scaling note: DEFERRED state increases stateful storage. we'll keep only key metadata and TTL index and compact tombstones after reclaim. compaction window should be configurable.
Andrew: migration: on deploy, mark in-flight provisional leases older than X as DEFERRED and emit `lease_event` so auditors can see the transition. that avoids a silent semantics change.
Jess: alerting thresholds: trigger P2 if `defer_rate` > 0.2% for 10m, P1 if >1% for 5m. also alert if `revalidation_success_rate` < 90% over 15m.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: metering-ingest config=defer-lifecycle-v1 by @Sam.
Sam: follow-up tasks I will do: update RFC with event schema, add migration script, and add SDK consumer guide for `lease_event`. planning canary in two regions next week.
Mira: add a quick local simulator to stress adaptive sampling before rollout.
Oz: one more thought: include a monotonic 'epoch' in provenance_tag to make dedupe cheap and monotonic across retries.
Sam: good call. will use `pfx:<fingerprint>:<epoch>` and have auditors dedupe by fingerprint+max(epoch).
Jess: will prep runbook and patch billing reconciliation to ignore DEFERRED until FINALIZED or RECLAIMABLE processed.
Sam: thanks all — i'll post the RFC update and migration PR today. :thumbsup:
